note: Live controls for internal/sync, the two-machine Git transport. Core owns the merge rules and catalogues them itself; these are the clauses sync owns — the lock, staleness, the deterministic export bytes and their predecessors, the commit/push/fetch, the chain-level fork proof, the sidecar lifecycle, and rekey. Seeded by dw32p.32.
